text:
The plate looks like it holds scrambled egg whites (or possibly mashed potatoes) next to roasted sweet potato and other vegetables.

The white mass is fluffy and looks like egg whites. I estimate about 200 g, which is roughly 100 kcal at about 0.5 kcal/g.

The roasted sweet potato cubes with some eggplant or other vegetables look like about 120 g. At roughly 1.1 kcal/g, with some oil, that comes to about 130 kcal.

Together that is about 320 g of food and about 230 kcal.
